services.name: Court Rental
services.desc: PLEASE NOTE: Our 24/7 availability requires you to input an access code on the door lock at our facility. In order for this system to function properly and ensure the best possible experience for you, you need to book at least 15 minutes in advance of the time you want to play. This applies to Court Rental only, not Open Play. Dink Shots’ 4 courts are open to members and non-members. Our facilities are open 24/7 with secure access and camera-monitoring in all public areas. NOTE ABOUT OPEN PLAY: By registering for our Open Play sessions, you acknowledge that your name will be publicly displayed on our website's participant list. This allows other players to see who is planning to attend each

services.name: Facility Rental
services.desc: With 4 courts and 24/7 access, Dink Shots will quickly become your go-to pickleball community. Four premium courts, ready for your next game. Bring a friend or bring a few - our membership options make it easy to get in your next game at any time of the day. We’ve even got some basic paddles for use if you want to try before you go all-in. Forgot your paddle or balls? Or maybe you got a little too competitive and need a replacement? Dink Shots has you covered. Our Pro Shop is open during all Open Play
